name: resource-balance
title: Resource Balance
author: funtik13
description: A floating panel that shows produced, consumed and balance per minute for the items and fluids you pick — per planet or summed over all planets and platforms. Includes a deficit finder, search and sorting, trend charts, a large chart window with smooth lines, comparison of up to 4 resources and a per-recipe breakdown of producers and consumers. Made for overhaul mods like Pyanodon's.
